escuinapa.translation: [地名] [墨西哥] 埃斯奎纳帕

escuintla.translation: [地名] [墨西哥、危地马拉] 埃斯昆特拉

esculapian.translation: [医] 医神艾斯库累普的, 医学的, 医生

esculapius.translation: 艾斯库累普(希腊罗马神话中的医神)

esculent.definition:
a. Suitable to be used by man for food; eatable; edible; as,
   esculent plants; esculent fish.
n. Anything that is fit for eating; that which may be safely
   eaten by man.
esculent.translation:
a. 可食用的
n. 可食用物

esculin.definition:
n. A glucoside obtained from the Aesculus hippocastanum, or
   horse-chestnut, and characterized by its fine blue fluorescent
   solutions.

esculin culture-medium.translation: [医] 七叶甙培养基(大肠杆菌现黑色集落)

escurial.definition:
n. A palace and mausoleum of the kinds of Spain, being a
   vast and wonderful structure about twenty-five miles northwest of
   Madrid.

escutcheon.definition:
n. (nautical) a plate on a ship's stern on which the name is inscribed
n. a shield; especially one displaying a coat of arms
escutcheon.translation:
n. 有花纹的盾, 孔罩
[医] 盾式分布(阴毛)

escutcheoned.definition:
a. Having an escutcheon; furnished with a coat of arms
   or ensign.

escutcheons.definition:
plural of escutcheon
n. (nautical) a plate on a ship's stern on which the name is inscribed
n. a shield; especially one displaying a coat of arms
escutcheons.translation:
